_method: For each route, an EXISTING handler test (or, for custody-report-read only, a probe that reuses the fixtures of an existing test) was run unaltered under ib126_capture_plugin.py, which wraps one callable and records the envelope the handler's boundary returned (synthetic test-fake values, kept in .scratch/, never copied). ib126_compare.py then validated the WHOLE envelope against the route's v1 response schema with test_seam_paired.py's own validator (_response_validator, imported) and compared the member names and JSON types of its `data` with the producer fixture's `instance`. A member present on one side only is optional_by_schema when the whole envelope still validates with it removed (tested, not assumed). Children of an empty object or array on either side cannot be compared and are listed as unobserved. Values are never compared or written. The recorded answers come from the tests' in-memory fakes: they show the SHAPE the handler's code emits for that fake world, not a byte read off the live function.
